description: 🌍 Welcome to My Delicious Markets! Join us as we explore the most fascinating markets and bazaars around the world — from bustling street markets to colorful local bazaars, from authentic food markets to hidden vintage markets and vibrant craft fairs. 🛍️ On this channel, you’ll discover: Real market atmosphere and local culture Authentic street foods, handmade products, fashion, and souvenirs Prices and cost of goods in markets around the world Tips for shopping like a local and finding unique treasures
name: my delicious markets - YouTube
